description: Re-textures an existing Meshy 3D model from 1-4 reference views of the same object (Meshy-7 only). Pass `meshy_task_id` plus `multiview_images`; the first image is the primary (front) view.

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

enable_original_uv.description: Use the original UV of the model instead of generating new UVs.

meshy_task_id.description: The task ID of a completed 3D model that needs to be re-textured.

pbr.description: Generate PBR Maps in addition to the base color (renamed `enable_pbr` on the wire).

texture_resolution.description: Base color texture resolution. Higher resolutions capture more surface detail; 8k costs 15 credits instead of 10.
